properties.description: Four tests driven through serving_for (crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_settling_cue_goes_to_whoever_can_give_the_word.rs): LOCAL, nobody named (the owner alone, a --call), on a design naming no owner and on one OWNED_BY who:bob → add_decision and replace_text offer set_decision_status and do not say "question for the owner"; a named caller on a design naming no owner → offered; a design OWNED_BY who:bob → who:ann is told it is a question for the owner (ask_question, no set_decision_status), who:bob is offered set_decision_status; BEHIND A TRUSTED GATEWAY (CallerRule::TrustedGateway "flo2.io") → named non-owner told it is a question, named owner offered, unnamed told it is a question, named caller on a no-owner design offered. a_loop_hint_says_where_the_node_landed.rs still passes (the "lands `proposed`" claim is kept).
properties.findings: At ab9ae9673 on ajs77 (rust 1.99.0): 4 passed; the whole MCP in_memory program 2133 passed, 0 failed, and cargo test --workspace --no-default-features passed. On af851306c the new a_local_call_made_for_nobody_is_offered_the_settling_call FAILED (line 96, question wording on a no-owner design) and the gateway test PASSED — the gateway behaviour is the same before and after. Through --call on a RocksDB build: af851306c said "a question for the owner" with 0 OWNED_BY edges; ab9ae9673 offers set_decision_status.
